I think {{t:children should clean their own rooms}}. I have three reasons.
First, it is our own {{v:space}}. We use our rooms every day. So {{g:we should take care of them|should + 동사원형: ~해야 한다}}.
Second, cleaning makes us {{v:responsible}}. I clean my room by myself. I put things back in the right place. Now I don't lose my things often.
Third, it helps our parents. Mom and Dad are very {{v:busy}} at work and at home. {{g:If we clean our rooms|If 조건절: '만약 ~한다면'}}, they can {{v:rest}} a little more.
Some people say children are too busy with homework. But cleaning a room doesn't take long. Just fifteen minutes a day is {{v:enough}}.
So, {{g:let's clean our own rooms|Let's + 동사원형: '~하자' (제안)}}. {{t:It is good for us and our families!}}

In my opinion, {{t:children should be responsible for cleaning their own rooms}}, and there are {{g:three main reasons why I believe this|관계부사 why: 앞의 reasons를 꾸밈}}.
First of all, a bedroom is a {{v:personal}} space. Since we spend time in our rooms every day, {{g:it is only natural that we should be the ones|가주어 it ... that 진주어: '~하는 것은 당연하다'}} to take care of them.
Second, cleaning teaches us responsibility. {{g:Ever since I started cleaning my room by myself, I have learned|현재완료(have learned) + ever since: ~한 이후로 쭉}} to put things back where they belong. As a result, I rarely lose my {{v:belongings}} anymore.
Third, it {{v:lightens}} our parents' load. Most parents are busy {{g:not only at work but also at home|not only A but also B: A뿐만 아니라 B도}}. If we take care of our own rooms, they can have a little more time to relax.
Some people argue that children are {{g:too busy with homework to clean their rooms|too ~ to ...: 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다}}. However, keeping a room {{v:tidy}} doesn't {{v:require}} much time. Spending just fifteen minutes a day is enough.
So, why not start cleaning our own rooms today? {{g:Doing so benefits|동명사 주어: 단수 취급 (benefits)}} not only ourselves but also our families!
